entry.title: Reinforcement Learning with GRPO, Clearly Explained!!!

media:group.media:title: Reinforcement Learning with GRPO, Clearly Explained!!!
media:group.media:description:
In 2024, the GRPO method for training Reasoning Models took the world by storm by simplifying the Reinforcement Learning stage of aligning a Large Language Model. In this StatQuest, we go through the GRPO loss function one step at at time, learning exactly what it does and how it does it. BAM!
NOTE: This StatQuest assumes that you are already familiar with... The Main Ideas of Neural Networks: https://youtu.be/CqOfi41LfDw Backpropagation: https://youtu.be/IN2XmBhILt4 Decoder-Only Transformers: https://youtu.be/bQ5BoolX9Ag
